# KING AI Customer OS

## English
KING AI Customer OS is the KING AI ecosystem product for customer support, sales assistance, lead capture, approved public knowledge and relationship intelligence. This public repository contains customer-safe product facts only.

Official ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work
